semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Techma GPM provides specialized pumps for semiconductor applications, which are critical for cooling and handling aggressive media in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Techma GPM distributes Sanso magnetically coupled centrifugal pumps, which are essential for cooling and handling aggressive media in semiconductor manufacturing. Their seal-less design minimizes maintenance and leakage, making them suitable for temperature-sensitive applications.
capabilities: Distribution of magnetically coupled centrifugal pumps
Seal-less pump design for no leakage

regional_presence.Europe: Techma GPM serves customers across Europe, including Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.
